# Assignment Schedule {.unnumbered}

One page for everything you submit this term: what is due, when, and whether it is your own work or your project group's. Click a deliverable to open its full brief.

::: {.callout-important title="Canvas is the source of truth"}
The dates below follow the Sept-Dec 2026 syllabus rule: **weekly assignments are due the Monday after class at 4:00 PM**, and milestone dates come from the syllabus milestone table. If Canvas shows a different date or time, Canvas wins.
:::

## How to read this page

- **Individual** items are the weekly assignments. You submit them alone.
- **Group** items are the term-project milestones. One submission per project group.
- **Taught in** links to the week whose class prepares you for that deliverable.
- Grading rules (Complete/Incomplete, best 4 of 6, project points) are explained on the [Assignments](index.qmd) and [Milestones](../milestones/index.qmd) pages.

## For the instructor: setting up Canvas

Every row in the [term at a glance](#term-at-a-glance) table maps to one Canvas assignment with the listed due date at 4:00 PM. Weekly assignments are individual submissions; milestones are group submissions (one per project group), with the Presentation and Final Portfolio as two Canvas items sharing the Dec 11 deadline. Weeks 0 and 1 hold the two ungraded checkpoints. Resolve the two † dates before publishing the Canvas calendar.
